The filing adds that the founders sold 878,769 ordinary shares for $6.0M 'in connection with this financing', and that Jeff Horing 'has served as a member of our board of directors since March 2011', which matches the panel month. NAME CONFLICT IN THE PRESS: TechCrunch (2011-03-28, https://techcrunch.com/2011/03/28/exclusive-flashy-website-creator-wix-raises-40-million/) and Wikipedia call the same event '$40 million in Series D funding led by Insight Venture Partners and DAG ventures'; the filing's share class is Series E and its 2010 round is the Series D. The filing is taken as the authority, so the judge's 'Series E' stands. The role (co-led with DAG) comes from TechCrunch, not the filing. amount_usd is the filing's primary amount; the press figure of $40M is not reconciled by the filing.
